name: Reminders - Follow up and keep moving

parameters.query:
WITH a AS (
  INSERT INTO tasks (lead_id, title, notes, due_at, priority)
  SELECT l.id, 'Follow up: ' || left(l.title, 80), 'Pitched ' || to_char(l.pitched_at, 'Mon DD') || ' with no reply yet.', now(), 'normal'
  FROM leads l
  WHERE l.status = 'Pitched' AND l.pitched_at < now() - interval '3 days' AND l.replied_at IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.lead_id = l.id AND t.title LIKE 'Follow up:%')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach o WHERE o.lead_id = l.id AND o.status IN ('queued', 'scheduled', 'sending'))
  RETURNING id
), b AS (
  INSERT INTO tasks (lead_id, title, notes, due_at, priority)
  SELECT l.id, 'Keep it moving: ' || left(l.title, 80), 'They replied ' || to_char(l.replied_at, 'Mon DD') || ' and nothing has happened since.', now(), 'high'
  FROM leads l
  WHERE l.status = 'Replied' AND l.replied_at < now() - interval '2 days'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.lead_id = l.id AND t.title LIKE 'Keep it moving:%')
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM a)::int AS follow_ups, (SELECT count(*) FROM b)::int AS keep_moving
